answer: Resist sybils by auditing the collateral graph instead: when a new key posts bond to register, the protocol does not count the bond, it traces whose bond it is. Collateral that traces back to a sibling already registered is rejected as recycled equity, so a farm cannot pledge the same capital across its puppets. Each accepted deposit must be independently originated and tagged to a distinct source, a lagoon of fresh inflow rather than a nebula of shared origins. The resulting signal is a tangle of separate roots, not one loop.
